notes.title: [Patch note Ver.1.002] Improved game stability and fixed minor bugs.
notes.notes:
Hello, 

We updated the game version.
In case you modified the game files before, please download the newest files and apply them.

Improved game stability.
Enabled skip battle in tutorial.
Fixed some garbled text of English version.
